cards.title: Welcome 👋
cards.description:
**ohnoban** is a personal kanban board that runs entirely in your browser.

No accounts, no servers — your board is saved in `localStorage` and survives reloads. Export to JSON anytime from the settings menu.

Delete these intro cards when you're ready to make the board your own.

cards.title: Drag, drop, reorder
cards.description:
Drag any card to move it between columns or reorder within one. Drop targets stretch to the full column height while dragging so you can't miss.

Columns themselves can be reordered with the **‹** and **›** buttons in their header.

cards.title: Markdown descriptions
cards.description:
Card descriptions support full markdown:

- **bold**, *italic*, ~~strikethrough~~
- `inline code` and fenced code blocks
- [links](https://example.com) (open in a new tab)
- bulleted and numbered lists
- raw HTML, including `<video>` and `<iframe>` embeds

> Click a card to view it, then hit **Edit** to change anything.

cards.title: Keyboard shortcuts
cards.description:
The whole board is keyboard-friendly:

- **Tab** through cards and controls
- **Enter** or **Space** opens the focused card
- **← →** move a card between columns
- **↑ ↓** reorder a card within its column
- **Esc** closes any open dialog

Moves work whether you're focused on the board or have a card open.

cards.title: Tags, your way
cards.description:
Open **⚙ Settings** to rename tags, change their colors, add new ones, or delete the ones you don't use. Tag text auto-contrasts against the background color so every color stays readable.

Renaming a tag updates every card that uses it.

cards.title: Make it yours
cards.description:
From **⚙ Settings** you can also:

- rename the board
- set a background image (tile, center, or stretch)
- export the whole board to a JSON file
- import a previously exported board

The board title auto-switches to white on dark backgrounds.

cards.title: Read this card ✅
cards.description:
Nice. Finished work lives here.

When you're ready to start fresh, delete each intro card with the red **Delete** button in its edit view, or clear everything by running `localStorage.clear()` in the browser console.

cards.title: Open source on GitHub
cards.description: ohnoban lives at [github.com/catskull/ohnoban](https://github.com/catskull/ohnoban) — star it, fork it, or file an issue.

notes.title: Notes 📝
notes.description:
The **Notes** tab is for anything that doesn't belong on the board — reference material, scratch ideas, meeting notes.

Notes have a title, markdown body, and tags, just like cards. They share the same tag palette, so renaming a tag updates notes too.

notes.title: Scratchpad
notes.description:
- they don't drag or sort into columns
- click one to view, **Edit** to change it
- they're saved and exported right alongside the board
